text: Based on the tool output, tree-cover loss on the property has been increasing in recent years. While there is a decrease from 2021 to 2022, the overall trend shows an increase in tree-cover loss when considering the total area lost over the three years. The data supports the claim of increasing tree-cover loss on the property in recent years.
